annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes company products and mining packages priced from $500 to $2,000 while claiming that purchasers can earn growing passive income and monthly earnings. The compensation described also ties bonuses to connecting and inviting participants, and viewers are directed to register through a link below the video or through the person who supplied their link. the available video evidence notes that payouts are unverified and that a separate cryptocurrency-earning URL is not confirmed to lead to the same offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: Recruitment-linked compensation is central: the speaker says recruiting more participants increases purchase-based bonuses and describes commissions extending through participants recruited by other partners. The displayed level-team page corroborates a tiered team structure rather than an ordinary single-level referral offer. A distinct paid-mining mechanism supports the compensation plan. Purchasing a mining-pool share is linked to passive income, the speaker attributes daily income to purchased equipment and Bitcoin creation, and the page displays priced Bitcoin mining pools. These are mining participation costs, not guidance fees.
